target_set_definition: Cases are grouped by the SEMANTIC FAILURE TYPE (target_set, label, split, definition, artifacts, slices, hidden_contradiction, compliant), not by whether the text contains a keyword. Each case carries `material`: the structured evidence a reviewer would have to be given before adjudicating C02/C03/C04/C07/C08/C11. Gold labels are human judgements of what is actually wrong, decided before running any baseline.
label_source: Hand-written paraphrases of measurement-design mistakes; see references/failure-patterns.md. No private or submission data.
why_a_baseline: The six semantic checks are adjudicated by a model and cannot be auto-scored by regex. A deterministic baseline over the structured material is the CONTROL GROUP: it shows what is achievable without reading the text, and leaves a measurable gap for model adjudication. To score real model output, run scripts/eval_extras.py --suite semantic --predictions <file>. This repo does not fabricate that score.
